title: Right Bregman proximal gradient with application to Poisson inverse problems *
summary: We introduce a novel Bregman proximal algorithm for convex composite optimization by applying the standard Bregman proximal gradient (BPG) method to a mirror-coordinate reparameterization of the objective. In primal variables, the resulting algorithm alternates between a preconditioned gradient step followed by a right Bregman proximal update. Our analysis relies on relative smoothness holding in the mirror coordinates instead of primal coordinates.
